After being driven to madness by the influence of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]] around [[3640 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] archaeologist, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kerrian]] retreated to a '''lair''' deep in the territory, where he resided until he was killed by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
